# A4.09 Task breakdown

## Owner
A4

## Stage
Plan

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
CP-03

## Input (reads)
Approved design doc

## Steps
1. Split the design into tasks sized for one PR.
2. Give each task a frontend, backend or test scope.
3. Link each task to its story ID

## Output (writes)
Task list with story links

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/architecture/tasks-<ID>.md`

## Verification
Every story maps to at least one task
